data.body_html:
Planning a group outing on the Costa del Sol? The Puerto Banus yacht charter cost per person 2026 ranges from €84 for a 2-hour cruise on a 12.5m Astondoa 40 to around €393 per person for a 4-hour trip on a 24m Mangusta 80. Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and Spanish VAT – no surprises. This breakdown covers our fleet, group sizes, and tips to keep your budget in check.

How the per-person cost works

We price charters per boat, not per person. The per-person cost depends on how many people you split it among. For example, the Astondoa 40 (9 pax) at €749 for 2 hours becomes €84 per person. The Azimut 39 (11 pax) at the same price drops to €69 per person if you fill it. Larger groups can bring the cost down further, but always stay within the boat’s certified passenger limit.

Tier A: Budget-friendly options (€749–€2,299)

Our Tier A boats – the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – start at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for a full 8-hour day. Both depart from Puerto Banús and include all standard inclusions: skipper, fuel, soft drinks, beer, wine, cava, snacks, insurance, and 21% VAT. For a 4-hour trip, the cost is around €1,299, making it €118–€144 per person for a full boat. These are ideal for small groups or budget-conscious travellers who still want a proper yacht experience.

Tier B: Mangusta 80 (from €4,719 for 4 hours)

The Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax, in white or grey) is our premium option. The minimum booking is 4 hours at €4,719, which includes a free jet ski. Per person, that’s €393 for 12 guests. For a half-day (6 hours) or full day, pricing is on request via WhatsApp. This yacht offers more deck space, a faster cruising speed, and a dedicated crew. It’s perfect for celebrations or a luxury day out.

Other boats and custom pricing

Our fleet includes 16 boats, from the 8m Dubhe (5 pax) to the 29m Ferretti 94 (12 pax). For any boat not in Tier A or Tier B, pricing is on request. Contact us via WhatsApp with your preferred boat, date, and group size. We’ll provide a custom quote within hours. All boats depart from Puerto Banús, so you’re always close to Marbella’s best beaches and restaurants.

What’s included in every charter

  • Licensed skipper (English-speaking)
  • Fuel for the entire trip
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (chips, nuts, olives)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21% VAT) – no hidden taxes

You can bring your own food, drinks, or music. The skipper will suggest a route – typically along the Marbella coastline past Cabopino, Cala del Faro, or towards Estepona. You’re free to swim, sunbathe, or explore at your own pace.

How to get the best per-person rate

To minimise the Puerto Banus yacht charter cost per person 2026, book a boat that fits your group size exactly. Overcapacity means you can’t bring everyone; undercapacity means you pay more per head. For 8–11 people, the Azimut 39 or Astondoa 40 are the most cost-effective. For 12, the Mangusta 80 or Azimut 58 Flybridge offer better value per person if you want a larger vessel. Early bookings (2–4 weeks ahead) secure the best availability and sometimes better rates.

Frequently asked questions

What is the cheapest yacht charter in Puerto Banús per person?

The cheapest option is the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 at €749 for 2 hours, which works out at €84 per person if you fill the boat (9 pax on Astondoa, 11 on Azimut). That includes skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and VAT.

Are drinks included in the charter price?

Yes. Every charter includes water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava. Light snacks are also provided. You can bring extra food or drinks on board if you wish.

Do I need to pay extra for the skipper or fuel?

No. The skipper’s fee and fuel are included in the listed price. There are no hidden extras – just show up and enjoy.

How many people can fit on a budget boat?

The Astondoa 40 takes up to 9 passengers, the Azimut 39 takes up to 11. For larger groups, consider the Mangusta 80 (12 pax) or Azimut 58 Flybridge (12 pax).

Is the Mangusta 80 worth the higher per-person cost?

If you want a 24m luxury yacht with a free jet ski, the Mangusta 80 is excellent value at €4,719 for 4 hours (€393/person for 12). It’s a premium experience with more space and speed.

Can I charter a boat for a full day?

Yes. Tier A boats are available for 8 hours at €2,299. For larger yachts, pricing is on request – contact us via WhatsApp for a custom quote.

What is the cancellation policy?

We recommend checking at the time of booking. Generally, deposits are refundable up to 48 hours before departure, but weather-related cancellations are handled flexibly.

Do I need to bring anything?

Just sunscreen, a towel, and your swimwear. The boat provides all safety equipment, insurance, and refreshments. You can also bring your own music via Bluetooth.
